verified_title: World–Value–Action Model: Implicit Planning for Vision–Language–Action Systems
problem: A one-shot generative policy can sample plausible but low-return futures. Searching raw long-horizon actions is difficult, while a learned latent prior does not automatically concentrate on successful trajectories.
contribution: WAV couples a video generator, trajectory-value diffusion module and action decoder; inference iteratively updates video/value noise distributions toward high-scoring latent futures before decoding controls.
algorithm: Autoregressive multiview video features condition value and action DiTs. Train video, then value with video frozen, then action/joint modules using flow objectives and discounted-return labels. At inference, sampleM video noises andN value noises per video, rank by predicted mean/std SNR, choose elites and update diagonal Gaussian means/variances with smoothing. This is elite-distribution optimization inspired by MPPI, rather than a verified feasibility projection.
observations: Language, current/memorized multiview RGB and robot state. Value labels use terminal-image MSE/SSIM, joint proximity and smoothness penalties from recorded trajectories; sparse success-only value training is also evaluated. Predicted value uncertainty is not independently calibrated.
actions: Eight-step chunks per planning call, all executed before replanning. Physical Piper has14D joint states, overview plus two wrist cameras. Exact action-space units should be resolved from the implementation before mapping to another embodiment.
embodiment_and_data: Physical task-specific models use300 successful drawer trajectories,300 bowl-organization trajectories and2000 towel-flattening trajectories. LIBERO supplies four suites. Training uses8A100-80GB GPUs for several days/task, with separate video/value/action training. Data release is promised upon publication in this PDF.
experiments: LIBERO compares one-shot, random selection, mean-value/max-SNR best-of-N, compute-matched best-of-N and iterative value-guided search with identical frozen modules. Real three tasks use strict binary complete-task success,15trials/task/method. Towel flattening is distinct from folding. Inference cost and accuracy are separately reported on a harder LIBERO-10 subset.
baselines: GE-Act with comparable backbone/architecture, pi0.5, published LIBERO policies and matched inference ablations. Theory compares against uniform action-space sampling under an assumed already-feasible latent generator, not against every strong structured policy or MPC baseline.

quantitative_result.simulation: PDFp7 Table1:98.1% LIBERO mean versus96.4% without planning; exact main evaluation trial denominator NOT_EXTRACTED. PDFp17 Table2:compute-matched best-of-N97.2%, full98.1%. Sparse-success value training98.4% versus dense98.1% (Table3), so dense reward is not universally superior.
quantitative_result.physical: PDFp8 Fig2/prose:average75.6% versusGE-Act35.6%,15trials/task across3tasks. This is strict binary trial success, unlike partial-score papers; no confidence interval supplied.
quantitative_result.compute: PDFp18 Table4:A100-80GB,K3/M30/N5 latency7.862s,p95 7.888s,peak32.0GB;one-shot0.909s/14.2GB. Harder-subset score70→82 butK5drops80. Reported1.02Hz equals8commands/7.862s, not one fresh planning decision each second.

limitations: Theory assumes the learned generator already places at least1−delta probability on feasible trajectories; the experiments do not prove this for contact-rich hardware. Maximizing over noisy value samples may exploit value errors, and SNR need not measure physical uncertainty. Iteration is not monotonically beneficial. Seconds-long planning and32GB memory target quasi-static tasks and exceed16GB NX's reported-memory budget. Physical cloth evidence uses2000 flattening demos, not autonomous sock folding.
code_and_license: No pinned implementation, weights or dataset terms audited and no execution. PDFp19 promises dataset release, which is not verified availability or a license grant.
hardware_adaptation: COMPARE offline outcome-based ranking on real held-out episodes and simulation trajectories. Use a compact value model with calibrated outcome labels before evaluating any latent search. Do not substitute generated futures for actual feedback or import Piper joint controls. Current32GB/7.9s planner has no demonstrated NX control role; existing controller settings remain unchanged.
